name: definition-transition-week-pattern-not-whole-weeks
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0), rejected by the cross-block checks on exceptions.history, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. A week_pattern transition from Sunday 2023-10-01, a week start, to 2024-01-01 lasts 92 days, not a whole number of weeks. The complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, exceptions (fiscalclock 0.2.0, ADR-0032), and spec/api-v1.md, Paths for common errors
